report.question:
make-checkpoint-gate-durable, task 7.3 (EnvironmentAttemptPersistence takes the round token from RoundTokenRef; previousTip and its currentTip() read at construction removed) has a design gap. 7.1 and 7.2 are done and ticked (RoundToken/RoundTokenRef, token path decisions/<stage>-a<attempt>-<token>.json, snapshot subject 'gnomish: snapshot <stage>#<round> <token>', SnapshotTipCheck reads the request into PendingVerification).

Gap: on the container resume path (kill between snapshot and state commit) ResumeVerificationStageExecutor.execute (adapters/agent/.../ResumeVerificationStageExecutor.java:64-83) returns Completed/DecisionNeeded WITHOUT openRound, so nothing records a token in the per-run RoundTokenRef. But the engine still persists that round (StageAttemptLoop.java:111,123 -> AttemptJournal.java:62 -> EnvironmentAttemptPersistence.persist, built in ContainerRunSupport.java:128-133 over the same ref). With previousTip replaced by roundToken.required() that persist throws and the task ends Aborted (ContainerModeResumeE2ESpec:212-263 drives exactly this). Today it works only by accident: previousTip read at construction IS the snapshot, so the boundary check compares the snapshot with itself. D10 and the D7 single-owner row name openRound as the only place a token is recorded; PendingVerification (shaped by 7.2) carries no token (SnapshotTipCheck.java:111 parses it and drops it); RoundTokenRef lives in adapters/git, which adapters/agent cannot see.

Recommended (A): PendingVerification gains the parsed token (String commit id, filled at SnapshotTipCheck.java:111-113); move RoundTokenRef (and RoundToken) to app/port/git next to AttemptCommitRef, its stated model; ResumeVerificationStageExecutor records the parsed token into the run's ref beside its existing attemptCommit.record(...) in the matching branch; persistence then uses the ref on both paths (the resumed round's boundary is actually checked). The D7 row would gain: openRound mints; the resume path records a parsed token at exactly one site. Persistence's constructor would reach 8 params, so the two per-run refs (AttemptCommitRef, RoundTokenRef) get grouped into one per-run value (ADR 0010 questions answered in implement.md). (B) same, but instead of moving the ref, pass a narrow token-recording callback into the executor, wired in ExecutorAdapterSelector.java:61; ref stays in adapters/git. (C) persistence keeps reading the tip when no round opened on this run (a second tip reader the task meant to remove) - not recommended.

I do not edit the design myself. After your answer I implement 7.3 per the choice, then 7.4-7.7, tick 4.3, then sections 5 and 6.

Side note: this decision file already held a stray question {"question": "Refactor or patch?"...} - most likely a fake-agent run inside a spec inherited GNOMISH_DECISION_FILE from this round's environment; I overwrote it.
options: A: token in PendingVerification, RoundToken/RoundTokenRef moved to app/port/git, executor records the parsed token; go ahead without a design edit
B: token in PendingVerification, executor records it through a callback wired in ExecutorAdapterSelector; ref stays in adapters/git
C: persistence falls back to reading the tip when no round opened this run
Stop: I will revise the design first
